def solve(inputs: dict) -> float:
    n = inputs.get('n', 179)
    k = inputs.get('k', 4)
    
    # Create a list of people (1-indexed positions)
    people = list(range(1, n + 1))
    idx = 0
    
    # Eliminate every k-th person until one remains
    while len(people) > 1:
        # Move k positions (k-1 because we count the current person)
        idx = (idx + k - 1) % len(people)
        people.pop(idx)
        # After removal, idx is already at the next position, but adjust if needed
        if idx == len(people) and len(people) > 0:
            idx = 0
    
    return float(people[0])
